verdict.rationale: Lambda's docs describe filesystems as regional data stores and note that only filesystems in the same region can be attached to a cluster. That implies storage is placed in a specific region, but the evidence never explicitly documents how a user picks that region or what residency guarantees apply. missing for 10: explicit documentation of choosing a storage region at creation, a list of available regions/geographies, data-residency or sovereignty guarantees (e.g., data never leaves the region), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: A filesystem is a high-capacity regional file store you can attach to your instance to store datasets and back up system state.
Existing filesystems in the same region can additionally be attached.
rulesets scoped to individual instances and their regions
